brief:
Palestinian political figure Yasser Mahmoud Abbas has contracted with a British public relations and training company to strengthen his presence in Palestinian public affairs, according to sources who spoke to Shehab Wire. The engagement marks a move to expand his role in the country's political landscape.

The British firm will provide training and public relations services designed to enhance Abbas's visibility and engagement across Palestinian affairs. Details of the contract's scope and duration were not disclosed by the sources.

title: Yasser Abbas hires British firm to boost Palestinian political profile
